title: 第3230章 收了个仆人第3229章 啥也不是
slug: 被女帝师父嫌弃的我竟举世无敌
lines: “怎么不说话了？”
“你倒是反驳啊。”
“难道是天性不爱说话吗？”
“你少特么管我。”
昊月族强者此时是真的有些崩溃了，妈的，一个打不过，一个说不过。
这特么可如何是好，难不成真的要当仆人不成？
“你能不能先告诉告诉我，你到底是什么人？”
“你是怎么做到修为这么低，实力这么强的？”
听到对方的话，陈长安笑着说道“我不是已经解释过了，只要足够优秀就可以了。”
“足够优秀？”
“你管这个叫足够优秀，这是太特么优秀了吧。”
“你这算是什么回答。”昊月族强者无奈的说道。
“可这就是答案。”
“不然你觉得，应该怎么做才能够做到这一步。”
陈长安的反问，把对方也问住了，这还真特么的没有办法解释，很多东西，可能都是天生的。
从出生的那一刻，就已经注定了每一个人以后得结局。
虽然不排除有逆天改命一般的存在，但这种存在少之又少，都是凤毛麟角。
“罢了，愿赌服输。”
“昊月族族人，关傲，见过主人。”
关傲？
“你叫关傲？”
“我知道了，你先起来吧。”
“是，主人。”
见关傲这么快就接受了自己的新身份，大黄也是有些惊讶。
毕竟这种站在云端高高在上的人物，可都不是那么容易就可以驯服的。
“大哥，这小子咋这么快就认了？不会是有诈吧？”
“我怎么感觉他憋着坏呢。”大黄看着陈长安问道。
“应该不会，他不敢。”
“拜托，我就站在这呢，你们两个说话是不是也得背背人啊？”关傲一脸无奈的看着陈长安和大黄。
“无妨，不怕听。”
content_en:
;;
"Why don't you speak?"
"You retort."
"Is it because you don't like to talk by nature?"
"Don't worry about me."
The strong men of the Haoyue Clan were really broken at this time. Damn it, none of them could beat them, and none of them could speak to them.
What the hell should I do? Do I really want to be a servant?
"Can you first tell me who you are?"
"How did you achieve such a low level of cultivation and such a strong strength?"
Hearing what the other party said, Chen Changan smiled and said, "I've already explained it. As long as you are good enough, that's all."
"Good enough?"
"You call this good enough, but this is too good."
"What kind of answer is this?" the powerful man from the Haoyue Clan said helplessly.
"But this is the answer."
"Otherwise, what do you think should be done to achieve this?"
"This..."
Chen Changan's rhetorical question stopped the other party in his tracks. There is really no way to explain this. Many things may be innate.
From the moment of birth, everyone's fate is destined.
Although it is not ruled out that there are existences that can change one's destiny against the will of heaven, such existences are very few and rare.
"That's all, I'm willing to admit defeat."
"Guan Ao, a member of the Haoyue Clan, has met his master."
Guan Ao?
"Your name is Guan Ao?"
"I understand, you should get up first."
"Yes, Master."
Dahuang was also a little surprised to see Guan Ao accept his new identity so quickly.
After all, such a high-flying figure in the clouds is not so easy to tame.
"Brother, why did this kid admit it so quickly? Isn't it a scam?"
"Why do I feel like he's holding it back?" Dahuang looked at Chen Changan and asked.
"Probably not, he wouldn't dare."
"Please, I'm just standing here. Do you two have to talk behind someone else's back?" Guan Ao looked at Chen Changan and Dahuang helplessly.
"It's okay, don't be afraid to listen."
